"""Exact complete source-header book publication, unchanged capacity and native rendered guidance."""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, need, pin, save

CHAPTER = Path('docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')
REGISTRY = Path('doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl')
ANCHOR = 'The complete finite raw-address and numerical/source parent acceptance is now\nqualified.'
TRANSFORMS = {'This closes the source-value parent only. Full source-generated original headers\nare the next separately owned step; original raw-header comparison, higher\nobserver/private/native and visual acceptance remain open.\n': 'The source-value qualification closes its own parent. Complete source-header\nqualification is described below; original raw-header comparison and higher\nobserver/private/native and visual acceptance retain their separate owners.\n'}
ADDITION = 'Complete original own source headers now have qualified source expressions.\nA separate direct traversal reconstructs every frame, argument, schema, ordered\nrole, phase group and load boundary. Restoring those expressions and their full\noperand bindings reproduces every complete original source mode. Whole inherited\ninner operands keep their dated evidence role.\n\nEvery expression retains all source arguments. Current conditional forms apply\nthe qualified public fixture grammar and an explicit profile: MaxArgLen 64, MaxArgNums 8, MaxEvalLen 0 and an\nundefined RefArgFormatter. Visible and hidden arguments remain separately\nallocated. The complete scalar and regex construction alternatives remain\navailable, including bounded and unlimited cases.\n\nFully known conditional forms produce whole header text. For example, a source\nbody with no supplied arguments has this selected current form:\n\n```json\n{"source_function":"main::__ANON__","source_arguments":[],"conditional_profile":{"MaxArgLen":64,"MaxArgNums":8,"MaxEvalLen":0,"RefArgFormatter":null},"known_conditional_header":"main::__ANON__()"}\n```\n\nOriginal reference tokens, regex flags and historical settings remain typed\nunmeasured boundaries. Their expression nodes retain complete source values,\nroles and qualified current alternatives. An unresolved slot supplies no guessed\nencoded token or wildcard matcher. The source do operation and diagnostic require\nmarker retain their separate full roles. Private framework and eval meanings\nremain unmeasured.\n\nWhole source/header/member/order/role/format/schema/value/encoding/profile and\nnative-promotion controls reject. The complete public grammar and actual main\nfixture plan/driver bindings qualify separately. Every prerequisite reexecutes\nin its qualified current-source or dated-publication context. Replay the full\nsource-selected qualification before original raw-header comparison:\n\n```sh\nscripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/observer-source-headers-20261011/verify.py\n```\n\nThis closes the unchanged source-header parent only. Original raw-header joining\nis next under its separate owner; observer/raw/native/private and visual\nacceptance retain their scopes.\n\n'


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*args],capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,'whole fixed book authority')
    return result.stdout


def aggregate(rows):
    return dict(files=len(rows),lines_total=sum(r.count(b'\n') for r in rows),bytes_total=sum(map(len,rows)))


def source():
    names = sorted(name for name in git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--','docs/book/src').decode().splitlines()
                   if Path(name).parent == Path('docs/book/src') and name.endswith('.md'))
    before = {name:git('show',REVISION+':'+name) for name in names}
    need(before[str(CHAPTER)].decode().count(ANCHOR)==1 and ADDITION not in before[str(CHAPTER)].decode(), 'unique source-header guide source seam')
    after=dict(before)
    changed=before[str(CHAPTER)].decode()
    for old,new in TRANSFORMS.items():
        need(changed.count(old)==1,'unique owned prior source-status wording')
        changed=changed.replace(old,new,1)
    after[str(CHAPTER)]=changed.replace(ANCHOR,ADDITION+ANCHOR,1).encode()
    return before,after


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--publish',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--native',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--native-output',default='book-native.json',choices=['book-native.json','book-native-final.json'])
    args=parser.parse_args()
    before,after=source()
    current={str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in Path('docs/book/src').glob('*.md')}
    if args.publish:
        need(current==before, 'publish only the owned sole source-header book addition')
        CHAPTER.write_bytes(after[str(CHAPTER)])
        rows=[json.loads(line) for line in REGISTRY.read_bytes().splitlines()]
        authority=next(r for r in rows if r.get('surface_id')=='shipped_behavior')['reference_contract']
        a,b=aggregate(list(before.values())),aggregate(list(after.values()))
        authority['aggregate_change']=dict(authority_id='OBSERVER-SOURCE-HEADERS-20261011',
            owner=(BASE/'scope.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0],baseline=a,
            delta={key:b[key]-a[key] for key in a},
            rationale='Document complete source-header expressions, lossless source allocation and known conditional public display forms while retaining every original unknown and separately owned raw/native/private boundary.')
        REGISTRY.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True)+'\n' for r in rows))
        save('book-publication.json',dict(revision=REVISION,addition=ADDITION,
            before={k:pin(v) for k,v in before.items()}, after={k:pin(v) for k,v in after.items()},
            authority=authority['aggregate_change']))
        print('PASS exact sole source-header book addition and fresh aggregate authority; capacity ceilings unchanged.')
    else:
        need(current==after, 'entire current source-header book publication and complete unchanged peers')
        if args.native:
            class Text(HTMLParser):
                def __init__(self):
                    super().__init__();self.parts=[]
                def handle_data(self,data):
                    self.parts.append(data)
            raw=Path('docs/book/book/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.html').read_bytes()
            reader=Text();reader.feed(raw.decode())
            rendered=ADDITION
            expected=' '.join(line for line in rendered.splitlines() if not line.startswith('```'))
            need(' '.join(''.join(reader.parts).split()).count(' '.join(expected.split()))==1,
                 'whole unique rendered source-header guide')
            save(args.native_output,dict(chapter=pin(raw),addition=pin(ADDITION.encode()),
                scope='Whole native guidance text and source custody only; visual book QA remains open.'))
        print('PASS complete current source-header guide and source publication; visual QA remains separately owned.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/observer-source-headers-20261011/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Fresh full source/value/display/publication qualification before header acceptance."""
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, VALUES, PUBLICATION, PREDICATE, SCALAR, REGEX, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, inputs, need, pin, save
from run import execute


def readers():
    namespace={'__name__':'header_source_prerequisites'}
    exec(compile((PREDICATE/'common.py').read_bytes(),str(PREDICATE/'common.py'),'exec'),namespace)
    result=dict(namespace['READERS'])
    boundary=Path('docs/audits/observer-value-profile-boundaries-20261010')
    result.update({
        'predicate-values':[str(PREDICATE/'verify.py')],
        'scalar-values':[str(SCALAR/'verify.py')],
        'regex-values':[str(REGEX/'verify.py')],
        'regex-dated-publication':[str(boundary/'checkpoint.py'),'--replay'],
        'remaining-value-boundaries':[str(boundary/'verify.py')],
        'remaining-value-dated-publication':[str(boundary/'publication_verify.py')],
        'source-value-parent':[str(VALUES/'verify.py')],
        'source-value-dated-publication':[str(VALUES/'publication_verify.py')],
        'source-value-dated-final-repair':[str(PUBLICATION/'verify.py')],
    })
    return result


if __name__=='__main__':
    fixed={}
    for path in inputs():
        command=['git','--no-replace-objects','show',REVISION+':'+str(path)]
        actual=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True)
        need(actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'' and actual.stdout==path.read_bytes(),
             'whole fixed/current source-header prerequisite input')
        fixed[str(path)]=dict(command=command,status=actual.returncode,identity=pin(actual.stdout))
    receipts={}
    for name,arguments in readers().items():
        actual=execute('prerequisite-'+name,['python3','-B',*arguments])
        receipts[name]=dict(context='complete fixed committed inputs' if 'dated-' in name else 'current fixed source inputs',
            receipt='actual-prerequisite-'+name+'-1.json',identity=pin(canonical(actual)))
    save('prerequisites.json',dict(revision=REVISION,fixed=fixed,readers=receipts,scope=SCOPE))
    print('PASS complete fresh source/value/display/header prerequisites and explicit dated-publication contexts.')

"""Independently conserve the complete book source set and every prior ceiling."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, canonical, load, need, pin, same, save
import book


def git(*args):
    actual=subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*args],capture_output=True)
    need(actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'','complete fixed publication source custody')
    return actual.stdout


def aggregate(data):
    return dict(files=len(data),lines_total=sum(x.count(b'\n') for x in data),bytes_total=sum(map(len,data)))


def main():
    need(sys.argv[1:] in ([],['--current']),'explicit dated or current publication role')
    names=git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--','docs/book/src').decode().splitlines()
    before={name:git('show',REVISION+':'+name) for name in names
            if Path(name).parent==Path('docs/book/src') and name.endswith('.md')}
    after=dict(before)
    need(before[str(book.CHAPTER)].decode().count(book.ANCHOR)==1,'unique complete book publication seam')
    changed=before[str(book.CHAPTER)].decode()
    for prior,replacement in book.TRANSFORMS.items():
        need(changed.count(prior)==1,'unique whole owned source-status correction')
        changed=changed.replace(prior,replacement,1)
    after[str(book.CHAPTER)]=changed.replace(book.ANCHOR,book.ADDITION+book.ANCHOR,1).encode()
    report=load('book-publication.json')
    need(report['revision']==REVISION and report['addition']==book.ADDITION
         and report['before']=={k:pin(v) for k,v in before.items()}
         and report['after']=={k:pin(v) for k,v in after.items()},'whole sole source-header guide change')
    original=[json.loads(line) for line in git('show',REVISION+':'+str(book.REGISTRY)).splitlines()]
    expected=json.loads(json.dumps(original))
    authority=report['authority'];a,b=aggregate(list(before.values())),aggregate(list(after.values()))
    need(authority['authority_id']=='OBSERVER-SOURCE-HEADERS-20261011'
         and authority['owner']==(BASE/'scope.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0]
         and authority['baseline']==a and authority['delta']=={k:b[k]-a[k] for k in a},'exact fresh book authority')
    next(r for r in expected if r.get('surface_id')=='shipped_behavior')['reference_contract']['aggregate_change']=authority
    metrics=load('publication-metrics.json')
    task=next(r for r in expected if r.get('surface_id')=='task_evidence')
    for dimension,value in metrics['task'].items():
        need(type(value) is int and value>0,'complete typed task measurement')
        allowance=task['baseline'][dimension]+task['transition']['max_growth'][dimension]
        if value>allowance:
            task['transition']['max_growth'][dimension]=min(value+task['transition']['ratchet_step'][dimension],
                task['enforcement_ceilings'][dimension])-task['baseline'][dimension]
        need(value<=task['baseline'][dimension]+task['transition']['max_growth'][dimension]
             <=task['enforcement_ceilings'][dimension],'measured task growth within unchanged ceiling')
    need(same(task,metrics['task_declaration']),'whole independently measured task declaration')
    need([r.get('enforcement_ceilings') for r in original]==[r.get('enforcement_ceilings') for r in expected],
         'every original capacity ceiling conserves')
    if sys.argv[1:]:
        need(expected==[json.loads(line) for line in book.REGISTRY.read_bytes().splitlines()],
             'every prior surface and Knowledge Map authority conserves')
        paths=sorted({p for pattern in task['targets'] for p in Path('.').glob(pattern)})
        data=[p.read_bytes() for p in paths]
        actual=dict(files=len(data),lines_total=sum(x.count(b'\n') for x in data),bytes_total=sum(map(len,data)),
            lines_each=max(x.count(b'\n') for x in data),bytes_each=max(map(len,data)),
            line_bytes_each=max(len(line.rstrip(b'\r')) for x in data for line in x.split(b'\n')))
        need(actual==metrics['task'],'complete actual current task dimensions')
        need({str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in Path('docs/book/src').glob('*.md')}==after,'complete current book source membership and bytes')
    proof=dict(before=pin(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(book.REGISTRY))),after=expected,
        scope='Sole exact book authority and measured task allowance; every prior surface/ceiling/Knowledge Map authority unchanged.')
    if (BASE/'publication-proof.json').exists():
        need(same(load('publication-proof.json'),proof),'whole immutable source-value publication proof')
    else:
        save('publication-proof.json',proof)
    print('PASS complete source-header book publication, measured task authority and unchanged prior surfaces/ceilings/Knowledge Map authority.')


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

"""Retain every actual command, stream and complete program epoch, including failures."""
import subprocess
import sys
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin, save


def execute(label, command):
    previous = list(BASE.glob('actual-' + label + '-*.json'))
    name = 'actual-' + label + '-' + str(len(previous) + 1) + '.json'
    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
                  stderr=result.stderr, programs=programs)
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout[-500:], result.stderr[-1000:], flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,
         'actual complete successful step: ' + name)
    return record


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'label and explicit command required')
    execute(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])

"""Complete source-header acceptance, genuine whole controls and immutable custody."""
import copy
import gzip
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, VALUES, CENSUS, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, inputs, load, need, pin, read, same, save
import contracts
import derive
import current_headers
import oracle
import prerequisites


def validate(product,current,task_contracts):
    result=oracle.validate(product,current)
    need(same(task_contracts,contracts.derive()),'complete unchanged source-header parent/child/raw-join acceptance')
    return result


def controls(product,current,task_contracts,write=False):
    result=[]
    def trial(name,mutate,cause):
        p,c,t=copy.deepcopy((product,current,task_contracts));mutate(p,c,t)
        need(not same([p,c,t],[product,current,task_contracts]),'genuine whole source-header hostile input')
        try:
            validate(p,c,t)
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error)==cause,'intended whole source-header control: '+name+': '+str(error))
        else:
            raise ValueError('accepted hostile source header: '+name)
        raw=gzip.compress(canonical(dict(product=p,current=c,contracts=t)),mtime=0)
        path=BASE/'controls'/('candidate-'+name+'.json.gz')
        if write:
            path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            need(not path.exists(),'retain complete first hostile candidate')
            path.write_bytes(raw)
        else:
            need(path.read_bytes()==raw,'whole retained candidate and actual replay: '+name)
        result.append(dict(name=name,cause=cause,status='rejected',candidate=str(path.relative_to(BASE)),identity=pin(raw)))
    field=lambda name:'entire independent source-header field: '+name
    trial('omitted-source-header',lambda p,c,t:p['headers'].pop(),field('headers'))
    trial('reordered-source-headers',lambda p,c,t:p['headers'].reverse(),field('headers'))
    trial('wrong-full-function',lambda p,c,t:p['headers'][0]['source_metadata'].update(function='borrowed'),field('headers'))
    header=next(i for i,r in enumerate(product['headers']) if len(r['source_argument_ids'])>1)
    trial('reordered-arguments',lambda p,c,t:p['headers'][header]['source_argument_ids'].reverse(),field('headers'))
    trial('wrong-header-delimiter',lambda p,c,t:p['headers'][header]['expression'].update(separator='; '),field('headers'))
    trial('borrowed-header-member',lambda p,c,t:p['headers'][header]['expression'].update(function=p['headers'][0]['expression']['function']),field('headers'))
    operand=next(k for k,v in product['operands'].items() if v['source']['qualification']['kind']=='qualified complete scalar value'
                 and type(v['source']['qualification']['value']) is str and len(v['source']['qualification']['value'])>64)
    trial('lost-complete-scalar-tail',lambda p,c,t:p['operands'][operand]['source']['qualification'].update(value=p['operands'][operand]['source']['qualification']['value'][:61]),field('operands'))
    trial('wrong-source-role',lambda p,c,t:p['operands'][operand]['source']['input'].update(role='borrowed'),field('operands'))
    trial('wrong-operand-schema',lambda p,c,t:p['operands'][operand]['source'].update(schema='borrowed'),field('operands'))
    guard=next(k for k,v in product['operands'].items() if v['source']['qualification']['kind']=='qualified whole guard construction'
               and v['source']['qualification']['string_value']=='')
    trial('borrowed-logical-zero-token',lambda p,c,t:p['operands'][guard]['source']['qualification'].update(string_value='0'),field('operands'))
    trial('convenient-wildcard-token',lambda p,c,t:p['operands'][operand]['original_token'].update(state='.*'),field('operands'))
    inherited=next(k for k,v in product['operands'].items() if v['source']['qualification'].get('evidence_role')=='inherited serialized evidence')
    trial('inherited-operand-promotion',lambda p,c,t:p['operands'][inherited]['source']['qualification'].update(evidence_role='new independent semantic oracle'),field('operands'))
    case=next(k for k,v in product['current_construction_cases'].items() if v['kind']=='regex')
    trial('wrong-current-regex-encoding',lambda p,c,t:p['current_construction_cases'][case]['case'].update(pattern_utf8=not p['current_construction_cases'][case]['case']['pattern_utf8']),field('current_construction_cases'))
    trial('lost-constructor-case',lambda p,c,t:p['current_construction_cases'].pop(case),field('current_construction_cases'))
    trial('lost-unframed-operand',lambda p,c,t:p['unframed_operand_ids'].pop(),field('unframed_operand_ids'))
    trial('lost-source-phase',lambda p,c,t:p['source_allocation'][0]['cases'].pop(),field('source_allocation'))
    trial('reordered-phase-groups',lambda p,c,t:p['source_allocation'].reverse(),field('source_allocation'))
    trial('source-do-promoted-to-require',lambda p,c,t:p['loads'][0].update(source_operator='require'),field('loads'))
    trial('diagnostic-marker-as-source',lambda p,c,t:p['loads'][0].update(diagnostic_marker_is_source_operator=True),field('loads'))
    trial('original-profile-borrowing',lambda p,c,t:p['original_unmeasured'].update(settings_formatter=dict(MaxArgLen=64)),field('original_unmeasured'))
    trial('original-private-meaning-promotion',lambda p,c,t:p['original_unmeasured'].update(private_framework_eval_meanings='qualified'),field('original_unmeasured'))
    trial('boolean-profile-integer',lambda p,c,t:p['current_profile'].update(MaxEvalLen=False),field('current_profile'))
    trial('omitted-fixed-source-input',lambda p,c,t:p['inputs'].pop(next(iter(p['inputs']))),field('inputs'))
    trial('original-raw-comparison-promotion',lambda p,c,t:p.update(raw_comparison='Full original encoded headers matched.'),field('raw_comparison'))
    conditional='entire independent known conditional header/unresolved/hidden allocation'
    known=next(i for i,r in enumerate(current['headers']) if r['known_conditional_header'] is not None)
    unresolved=next(i for i,r in enumerate(current['headers']) if r['unresolved_slots'])
    trial('wrong-whole-known-header-tail',lambda p,c,t:c['headers'][known].update(known_conditional_header=c['headers'][known]['known_conditional_header']+'borrowed'),conditional)
    trial('unresolved-reference-guessed',lambda p,c,t:c['headers'][unresolved].update(known_conditional_header='HASH(0x123)'),conditional)
    trial('lost-unresolved-slot',lambda p,c,t:c['headers'][unresolved]['unresolved_slots'].pop(),conditional)
    trial('omitted-conditional-header',lambda p,c,t:c['headers'].pop(),conditional)
    trial('raw-scope-promotion',lambda p,c,t:p.update(scope='Original raw/native/private observer qualified.'),'unchanged complete source-header qualification scope')
    owner=(BASE/'scope.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0];parent=owner.rsplit('.',1)[0]
    task='complete unchanged source-header parent/child/raw-join acceptance'
    trial('narrowed-original-parent-acceptance',lambda p,c,t:t['original_bodies'].update({parent:t['original_bodies'][parent].replace('Acceptance:','Borrowed:',1)}),task)
    trial('lost-prerequisite-child-contract',lambda p,c,t:t['original_bodies'].pop(parent+'.2'),task)
    return result


def custody():
    qualified=load('prerequisites.json')
    need(qualified['revision']==REVISION and qualified['scope']==SCOPE,'complete source-header qualification epoch/scope')
    need(set(qualified['fixed'])=={str(p) for p in inputs()},'whole source-header fixed input membership')
    for path in inputs():
        command=['git','--no-replace-objects','show',REVISION+':'+str(path)]
        actual=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True)
        need(actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'' and actual.stdout==path.read_bytes()
             and same(qualified['fixed'][str(path)],dict(command=command,status=0,identity=pin(actual.stdout))),
             'whole fixed/current source-header input custody')
    readers=prerequisites.readers();need(set(qualified['readers'])==set(readers),'complete fresh header prerequisite reader set')
    for name,arguments in readers.items():
        item=qualified['readers'][name];actual=load(item['receipt'])
        context='complete fixed committed inputs' if 'dated-' in name else 'current fixed source inputs'
        need(item['context']==context and actual['command']==['python3','-B',*arguments]
             and type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status']==0 and actual['stderr']=='' and 'PASS ' in actual['stdout']
             and item['identity']==pin(canonical(actual)),'whole actual fresh prerequisite and its qualified publication context')
    command=['python3','-B',str(VALUES/'verify.py')]
    actual=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    need(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr=='' and actual.stdout.startswith('PASS '),
         'fresh whole source-value parent and dated-publication custody replay')
